Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Many, many thanks for prompt [payment](../others.html#160), an agreeable sight on a winter’s morning I think [the story](../books.html#131) in the [Monthly Packet ](../others.html#52)will finish there about next spring It is not longer than the [Three Brides](../books.html#120), but has been in short chapters. I have not finished writing it yet, but the beginning may be printed when it is convenient. I am correcting the [Moors and Christians](../books.html#126) gradually, and will send the result soon I see one or two little corrections are wanting in the [Primer](../books.html#353).

When shall I send them

Yours truly

C M Yonge
